name: Gap, improvement or new component
about: An app needs something Shade's API cannot do
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**Need:** what the app is doing, and why the current API cannot (name the control and Shade version).

**Ask:** the public API you wish existed (property, slot, event, option, placement), as a sketch. For a new
component: name, what it does, which existing control comes closest.

**Notes:** mode, accent or culture if it matters.
